name: grpo_rev2
note: Use exactly this and make the placement robust. (1) plan_grasp the green cube; move the end-effector to that grasp pose with its full orientation, close, lift 0.2m. (2) Take a FRESH observation; estimate the grasped green cube center by backprojecting its mask to 3D and, before the oriented bounding box, KEEP ONLY points within 0.07 m of the median point height (the SAM mask can contain stray non-cube pixels; the lifted cube is isolated so its mask is clean); the cube is rigidly held by the gripper, so this center is accurate. (3) offset = grasped_center - current_end_effector_position. (4) place_z = red_center_z + red_half_z + green_half_z; move the end-effector to (red_center_x - offset_x, red_center_y - offset_y, place_z - offset_z) so the CUBE center lands on the red cube center (NEVER move the end-effector to the red cube center directly; the cube is held at a fixed offset from it). (5) move there at a safe height, descend, place, open. Re-estimating the grasped center from the lifted observation and rejecting stray pixels is what makes it succeed on every seed.
